title: Read, use and release Altium Designer licenses
summary: Shows how to reach ILicenseManager, ISecurityManager and ISecurityServerManager from an extension, read the license and subscription state, and use or release licenses (alf file, name, PLS serial, on-demand) behind a dry-run guard.
phrasings: read the current license and subscription expiry
release a leased license from code
use an on-demand license from the license server
check whether the subscription is current

commands.name: GetLicenseInfo
commands.description: Refresh and show the security manager's license information

commands.name: CheckADLicense
commands.description: Show the license manager's state and the .alf files
commands.params: [SecurityFolder=<folder with *.alf files; default: derived from the running installation>]

commands.name: SecurityServerInfo
commands.description: Show the security server manager's state

commands.name: ReleaseLicenses
commands.description: Release leased licenses (dry run unless Confirm is set)

commands.name: UseLicenseFile
commands.description: Use a license from an .alf file, then release it (needs File, Server, Confirm)

commands.name: UseLicenseByName
commands.description: Use a license by name (needs Name, Confirm)

commands.name: UseLicenseBySerial
commands.description: Use a PLS license by serial, then free it (needs Serial, Confirm)

commands.name: UseOnDemandLicenses
commands.description: Lease the on-demand licenses, then return them (needs Confirm)

commands.name: AddLicenseFile
commands.description: Pick and load a standalone .alf file (dialog; needs Confirm)
commands.params: Confirm=true|[Replace=true] (menu item passes Confirm=true; interactive only)
